title: Design: A/R Summary sorted by Location matches the design picture
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: A customer owes you money at two locations, and you sort A/R Summary by Location to compare with the design picture.
  • You are an Admin user (the "Admin" role) working at {Location-A}, your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open documents in these reports at two locations, {Location-A} and {Location-B}, and you are enrolled at both; {Location-A}'s name comes first in A to Z order.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has open invoices at both locations on today's date.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST D-69 Monroe.
  • Starting screen: A/R Summary (Reports, then "A/R Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu in light theme at 100% zoom.
  • The design picture "Summaries show "Multiple"" (ar-ap-p4-summaries-show-multiple.png) is attached to this case and open beside the browser at 100% zoom; compare the layout, labels and styles, not the names and amounts, which are only examples.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "Location" header.
  2. Widen the browser window to 1536 px and look across the page.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the rows sort by Location, A to Z, as in the picture: "Location" carries the small up arrow and "Customer" none; the rows reading "Multiple" come first, {Customer-A} among them, then each location's rows.
  • Step 2: nothing overlaps, is cut off or clipped; the layout is the same as at 1440 px.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11532 (Story 2, Sort by clicking any column header), story SV-11536 (Story 6, Location column)

  • S6-R4: “On A/R Summary and A/P Summary a row shows the location's name when all of that customer's or vendor's open documents at the chosen locations are at one location, otherwise "Multiple".”
  • S6-R5: “The column sorts A to Z on its first click; "Multiple" sorts as text.”
  • S2-R2: “The first click gives the useful order for the kind of data: text (names, Location, Transaction Type) A to Z; money columns largest first; dates oldest first; Past Due largest first; ID and No. smallest number first (S2-R4). The second click reverses it. The third click repeats the first; there is no unsorted state.”
